program:
(def ch [s i] (if (lt i (text-len s)) (nth s i) 0))
(def skip [s i] (if (eq (ch s i) 32) (skip s (inc i)) i))
(def isdig [c] (and (ge c 48) (le c 57)))
(def num [s i acc] (if (isdig (ch s i)) (num s (inc i) (merge (mul acc 10) (sub (ch s i) 48))) (rec pos i out acc)))
(def primary [s i]
  (let j (skip s i)
    (let c (ch s j)
      (cond (eq c 45) (let r (primary s (inc j)) (put r out (neg (get r out))))
            (eq c 40) (let r (expr s (inc j)) (rec pos (inc (skip s (get r pos))) out (get r out)))
            (num s j 0)))))
(def term [s i] (let r (primary s i) (term-rest s (get r pos) (get r out))))
(def term-rest [s i v]
  (let j (skip s i)
    (let c (ch s j)
      (cond (eq c 42) (let r (primary s (inc j)) (term-rest s (get r pos) (mul v (get r out))))
            (eq c 47) (let r (primary s (inc j)) (term-rest s (get r pos) (div v (get r out))))
            (rec pos j out v)))))
(def expr [s i] (let r (term s i) (expr-rest s (get r pos) (get r out))))
(def expr-rest [s i v]
  (let j (skip s i)
    (let c (ch s j)
      (cond (eq c 43) (let r (term s (inc j)) (expr-rest s (get r pos) (merge v (get r out))))
            (eq c 45) (let r (term s (inc j)) (expr-rest s (get r pos) (sub v (get r out))))
            (rec pos j out v)))))
(get (expr {s} 0) out)

(def lower [c] (if (and (ge c 65) (le c 90)) (merge c 32) c))
(def punct [c] (or (eq c 46) (or (eq c 44) (or (eq c 33) (or (eq c 63) (or (eq c 59) (eq c 58)))))))
(def strip-front [cs] (if (nil? cs) cs (if (punct (head cs)) (strip-front (tail cs)) cs)))
(def clean [w] (text-of-chars (reverse (strip-front (reverse (strip-front (map lower w)))))))
(def count-all [m ws] (if (nil? ws) m (count-all (map-count m (head ws)) (tail ws))))
(def better [a b] (let ca (get a n) (let cb (get b n) (if (ne ca cb) (gt ca cb) (text-lt (get a w) (get b w))))))
(def line [e] (join (list (get e w) (text-of (get e n))) 32))
(let m (count-all (map-of (nil)) (filter (lambda w (text-len w)) (map clean (words {text}))))
  (join (map line (take {k} (sort-by better (map (lambda k (rec w k n (map-get m k 0))) (map-keys m))))) 10))
